1. CLOTHES SHOP — The ground-floor changing room is closed. Please try clothes upstairs today.

2. Hi Jo, you left your grey scarf at my house. Come and collect it after school. Mia

5. RAINCOATS — Leave wet coats here to dry. Do not put them inside your bag yet.

6. FOR SALE — Old blue jumper, £4. Ask the school office if you want to buy it.
